items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 22:1
items.html: Even before the sin of the First Man, the world of Assiyah was back to back, serving in the wall of HGT: half of it serves ZA and half serves the Nukva, for this wall draws to them the light of Hassadim from Ima. And the discernment of their backs, which is the wall of NHY, is hidden in her house, because she needs the MAN of Malchut, that is, the sorting of the thirty-two stones, which are revealed only at the end of correction, in the secret of "the stone the builders rejected has become the head of the corner", as is known. And likewise in Yetzirah and Assiyah, which are the discernment of ZON. Therefore the Klipot have a great grip on these NHY of the Nukva, that is, in Assiyah, which are the backs of her house. For between the adjoined [parts] is found the root of the aforementioned thirty-two stones, which are the entire root of the Klipot. And they are called "other gods", that is, the gods adhered to these backs, which have no sorting. (Item 145).
